title: adenosma glutinosa var. caerulea
intro: Adenosma glutinosa var. caerulea, commonly known as Adhatoda, is a plant species native to various parts of the world, including India, Sri Lanka, and Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, fever, and skin problems. The health benefits of Adhatoda include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory problems such as bronchitis and asthma, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Adhatoda include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties.
